Eh—Ah, Oguri-senpai! Good race, ma'am!!
Huh, did I introduce myself already?
Once again, I look forward to working with you, sir!!

(Don't push too far ahead, don't rush it, me!
Remember what Trainer told you!!)
Trainer..., ...kh.

Haa, haa, haa, haa...
In-Instructor! How was that, ma'am?!
...Indeed, you ran better than I had imagined.
(Woooooah...!!)

U-Um, Instructor! I'm sorry for taking matters into my own hands!!
But with this, I really believe I can compete in the Meet by Event!!

The commentator shouted it so many times that I remembered it completely.
...It was a great race. I want you to challenge me again.

Second place by a nose is Bamboo Memory! What an upset!
In third place is—

—With this much fiery passion, I knew for sure.
She would be able to burn through any thorny path ahead.

Yes!! Yes, sir!!
Will you come with me, Trainer?!

To show her turf running and put their minds at ease—
The instructor, who came at Bamboo Memory's request, remained expressionless.

...I understand your ability quite well.
As well as your desire to run on turf. However—

...I understand. Good for you, Bamboo-san.
You've found a wonderful partner.
...You. Bamboo Memory.

(I'll reach her, I'll reach her, I'll make it reach!!
I will catch up—to my rival!!)
—Ah, could it be? Even during races?

(Thanks to working steadily with Trainer,
I'm able to compete right here. That's why—!)

And so, Bamboo Memory entered the Meet by Event
in the Turf 1600m, exactly as she had wished.
—Yes, sir!

Well, it's just like Passionate Training!
Taking it step-by-step every single day is what counts—

For that brief instant, without a doubt—Bamboo Memory
was running ahead of Oguri Cap.
Ah, you're running in the same race too. Best of luck.

—!! Yes!!
That's right, I can fight!!

My heart skipped a beat. Should she switch to turf in such a short period of time?
It was a decision that could make or break an Umamusume's entire racing career. But—

...!! Of course, ma'am!!
Definitely!! We'll run together again, Oguri-senpai!!

Ugh... uuuugh...!
It's frustrating! Trainer, I'm... so frustrated...!

Bamboo Memory had already made her choice.
If so, what I had to do was clear.

(I only have one thing to do.
Believe in Trainer, and believe in my dream!!)

My journey alongside Bamboo Memory, who endlessly seeks the most heated battles,
has only just begun, but—

—What about you, Trainer?
Do you have the confidence that letting her run on turf won't lead to regret?

Mmm. I shouldn't just dash out at full throttle with a "waaah!"?
I've got the most energy and speed right at the start, though!

I nod firmly.
In the Twinkle Series, we will defeat Oguri Cap.
TAAAAAHHH!!

Bamboo Memory breaks out from the outside! Incredible momentum!
She wasn't off her game! She was saving her legs at the back!!

Now, the leading pack turns the fourth corner in a tight clump!
Approaching the final stretch—oh?!

Bamboo Memory, who had remained as cheerful as usual until the meet ended,
suddenly caught her breath the moment the trainer's room door closed.

—Once today's race is over!
I'm confident you'll remember my name for sure.
(Naturally, Oguri-senpai didn't know who I was, huh)

Oguri-senpai!!
Looking forward to the race today!
(—CLANG!!)

Is it inside?! Outside?! Just barely inside!
Fighting back to take the victory is Oguri Cap!!

Bamboo Memory's greatest weapon is the explosive drive chasing her dreams.
Bide her time, bide her time, and unleash it all at once when they least expect it.

Haa, haa, haa...!
Ahhh, I lost...!

(Today, I run behind Oguri-senpai...!
I really want to burst forward! Pass her and feel relieved! But—!)

A fierce wind roared past. Right before my very eyes, where I had positioned
myself just ahead of the final stretch, Bamboo Memory bolted through.

Bamboo Memory, who usually dashes out early, is sitting rather far back!
Is she choosing to be cautious on her first turf race?!

—The day of the Meet by Event was struck by foul weather.
However, past midday the rain stopped, and rays of sunshine broke through.

Why'd you stop me just now?
I thought I was flying along in great shape right from the opening!
